name: std::ranges::uninitialized_fill

declarations.code:
template <no - throw -forward - iterator I, no - throw -sentinel - for<I> S,

    class T >

            requires std::constructible_from<std::iter_value_t<I>, const T &>

        I uninitialized_fill(I first, S last, const T &value);

template <no - throw -forward - range R, class T>

    requires std::constructible_from<ranges::range_value_t<R>,

        const T &>

ranges::borrowed_iterator_t<R> uninitialized_fill(R &&r,

    const T &value);

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
first, last

 -

 iterator-sentinel pair denoting the range of elements to initialize


 r

 -

 value

 -

 the value to construct the elements with

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the uninitialized memory area.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: Any exception thrown on construction of the elements in the destination range.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
An implementation may improve the efficiency of the ranges::uninitialized_fill, e.g. by using ranges::fill, if the value type of the output range is TrivialType.

sections.title: Possible implementation

summary: 1) Copies value to an uninitialized memory area [first, last) as if by for (; first != last; ++first) ::new (voidify(*first)) std::remove_reference_t<std::iter_reference_t<I>>(value); return first;
